_why: One corpus, two readers: test_params.py (params.extract_params) and test_param_names.mjs (paramNamesIn in static/js/params.js). The browser picks which tiles a filter re-runs and which values it posts from this list, so a name one side collects and the other does not is a filter that silently does nothing or wastes a run (#671, #683). Expectations are what the server does: a name inside a comment is not a param, a name inside a string literal still is (lint refuses it by name, #678).
